question: Estimate the number of distributors Coca-Cola needs in Maharashtra to serve the state effectively.
idealClarificationQuestions: Distributors (1-tier wholesalers, take bulk product from CC and resell to retailers)? Yes.
All Coca-Cola portfolio (Coke, Thums Up, Limca, Sprite, Maaza, water, juice)? Yes.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Frame the approach
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Total retail outlets to be served / outlets per distributor.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Maharashtra kiranas: ~15-16 lakh (state population ~9% × national kirana count).

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Plus general trade other (paan shops, sweets, juice corners, restaurants): ~10 lakh.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Plus ~300 specialized (cold-chain frozen products like Maaza Aam Panna).

benchmarkAssumptions.parameter: Plus modern trade + HoReCa + institutional outlets

benchmarkAssumptions.value: ~200 super-distributors / WCEDS (warehouse-cum-distribution centers) at top + ~3,500 second-tier route distributors.

calculationFlow: Maharashtra kiranas: ~15-16 lakh (state population ~9% × national kirana count).
Plus modern trade + HoReCa + institutional outlets: ~25,000.
Plus general trade other (paan shops, sweets, juice corners, restaurants): ~10 lakh.
But CC categorizes: ~200 super-distributors / WCEDS (warehouse-cum-distribution centers) at top + ~3,500 second-tier route distributors.

finalAnswerRange.ideal: Plus ~300 specialized (cold-chain frozen products like Maaza Aam Panna).
